objectives.description: Prove finding-set equivalence for the complete battery against pre-task capture, 3 known pre-existing failures present on both sides
objectives.note: Ran the explicit source-store target full battery twice (run1 --jobs auto, run2 --jobs 2; rc=1 both times, '4 of 37 check(s) failed' both times). Every finding in both captures traces to an already-known/documented cause: gate3 (lean4 doc-lint index.json entry -- named pre-existing), gate4 (task-reference-exemptions.md:48 -- confirmed pre-existing via objective 2's git-blame investigation; re-appeared identically in an isolated --only-gate 4 run), gate20 (eager-load 988B over baseline -- named pre-existing, exact figure match), gate8's three named pre-existing suites (test-detect-noop-bash.sh, test-four-tier-conflict.sh, test-guard-git-push.sh) plus test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh (already root-caused in Phase 10's progress note as a cascade from gate20's eager-load overage). gate16 is a non-blocking [WARN] (never increments FAILURES per verify-deploy.sh's warn() contract) and unrelated to this task. Two additional, non-recurring findings surfaced under live ambient contention from concurrent sibling sessions -- a gate4 TIMEOUT in run1 and a gate8 test-update-task-status.sh failure in run2 -- both investigated and confirmed to be transient contention artifacts, not regressions: see deviations entries below and issues.jsonl.

objectives.description: Prove determinism: repeated complete runs at several worker counts produce identical gate verdicts and identical summary lines
objectives.note: The registry's own worker-count determinism is proven at the controlled-fixture level by test-gate-registry-resolution.sh case19 (identical CHECKS sum and findings set at worker counts 1, 2, 4) and test-run-all-selection.sh (26/26 and 19/19 passing, respectively covering gate-level and suite-level scheduling). The two live full-battery runs (--jobs auto vs --jobs 2) produced the IDENTICAL final summary line ('[verify-deploy] FAIL -- 4 of 37 check(s) failed') and identical per-gate PASS/FAIL verdicts for every gate except gate8's suite-level and gate4's presentation noise, both demonstrated transient (see objective 4 note) rather than worker-count-dependent.
